review.notes: Triage pass within a fixed time budget. Full structural scan of all 845 OCR lines (zero code fences; heading inventory checked against the PDF). Full-document automated droppage scan: per-page normalized 4-gram containment of PDF text vs OCR markdown, then sentence-level 6-gram inspection of every low-hit page - the only prose droppage found is the Appendix E opening block on physical p.55 (restored here); remaining low scores trace to flattened longtable cells (A2-A8) and figure-internal chart text. Line-by-line reading covered the section 4 figure region and appendices A2-F; references (physical pp.23-25) were checked by DOI and URL set comparison (all 6 DOIs and all non-line-wrapped URLs match; no dropped entries detected) rather than line-by-line. Pages 12-13 and 33, 55, 58 were rendered and visually inspected; p.56-57 verified against the text layer consistent with the p.55/p.58 renders. No spaced-digit garbles, no \_ escapes outside bullet prefixes (bullet style not treated as a defect), no footnote apparatus in this source. The 'General purpose benchmarks' paragraph split around the Figure 2 bubble text matches physical page order and was left in place. Table 5's caption is emitted as the first row of its table while Table 6's caption is a separate line; both match the print's longtable rendering and were left unchanged.
